rca_diagnosis.title: Ball Pass Frequency Outer Race (BPFO) Spalling
rca_diagnosis.root_cause: Acoustic emissions reached 71.5 dB with 2.96g radial shock pulse. Fast Fourier Transform indicates 2.4kHz harmonic sideband modulation consistent with outer raceway defect.
rca_diagnosis.corroboration_equation: INMP441 Acoustic (71.5 dB) + MPU-6050 Vibration (2.96g) > 0.38 corroboration threshold.
recommended_actions: Issue electrical Lockout / Tagout (LOTO) on induction motor REZON-01.
Perform mechanical vibration spectral analysis on drive-end bearing bracket.
Disassemble bearing housing; inspect raceway for pitting, flaking, or lubrication starvation.
Replace cartridge with genuine ISO 281 rated SKF/NSK deep-groove bearing assembly.
Recalibrate SW-420 and MPU-6050 sensory baselines upon re-commissioning.
